description: Upcoming live shows, tours, talks and events of Argentine streaming people and channels, in Argentina and abroad: date and time where it happens, venue, city, line-up and ticket link, with the canonical url of each event's page on prim.profblu.com. Filter by city (e.g. Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Madrid), by dates or by a name in the line-up. Answers in the language requested with lang (es, en, it).

from.description: From this day, YYYY-MM-DD (local to the event).

lang.description: Language of the answer: es (Spanish), en (English) or it (Italian). Defaults to es. Use the language the user writes in.

limit.description: How many events, 1 to 25. Defaults to 10.

query.description: A name in the line-up or in the title, e.g. «Nadie Dice Nada».

to.description: Until this day, YYYY-MM-DD (local to the event).

name: upcoming_events

citiesWithEvents.description: Only when the city asked for has no upcoming events

date.description: Date in Buenos Aires time, YYYY-MM-DD: the one prim.profblu.com shows

localTime.description: Start time at the venue's own time zone, HH:MM

time.description: Start time in Buenos Aires time, HH:MM: the one prim.profblu.com shows

url.description: Canonical page of the event on prim.profblu.com: cite it

title: Upcoming shows of Argentine streaming people
